description: Angular component for a time unit input control, handling validation, conversion, and user interaction for selecting a time value with units.

classes.name: TimeUnitInputModel
classes.description: Interface representing the model for time input with value and unit.

classes.name: TimeUnitInputComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a time input with unit selection, validation, and conversion logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up validators, and subscribes to form value changes.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updating validators and time units accordingly.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not used here).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a new value to the form, updating the input fields.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the form and returns validation errors if any.

methods.name: updatedModel
methods.description: Updates the internal model and propagates changes.

methods.name: parseTime
methods.description: Converts a total seconds value into a time and unit object.

methods.name: createStepMultipleOfValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator function to check if the time value is a multiple of a specified step.

methods.name: updatedAllowTimeUnitInterval
methods.description: Adjusts available time units based on maximum allowed time.

methods.name: refreshTimeValidators
methods.description: Recalculates and applies validators for the time input control.
